messages:
Alice: Quick coordination — finalizing merge-freeze & staggered handovers for next release. Proposed: merge-freeze 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC. Handover canaries: US -> EU -> APAC with 30m buffer. Can everyone ack if that works? We'll need changelog push by freeze + QA signoff.

Ben: Ack on timing, but prefer 1h buffer between canaries in case of rollback. Also request branch-protection disable window: 18:10-18:40 UTC for hotfixes only.

Carol: SRE prefers larger cushion for database migrations — 1h between US/EU. If no DB changes, 30m is fine.

Dmitri: If we do 1h, proposed sequence: US canary 19:00-19:30 UTC, EU 20:30-21:00 UTC, APAC 22:30-23:00 UTC. Routing policy: start with blue pool in each region, shift 25%->50%->100%.

Emily: QA will run smoke + regressions in parallel to canary ramp. ETA for smoke results: 12m after canary start. I'll post results in this thread.

Ben: Changelog note reminder: please add to CHANGELOG.md under unreleased. Quick commands:
```
git checkout release-v2
git cherry-pick <commit>
git tag -a v2.15.0 -m "release v2.15.0"
```
Also ping @release-bot to create canary jobs.

Alice: OK pushing final: merge-freeze 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC. Will send calendar invites and update release playbook. Everyone react with :thumbsup: if aligned.

release-bot: Canary jobs queued for US/EU/APAC windows. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/releases/1852107890

Maya: +1. Will own rollback if QA flags anything.

Carol: Noted. I'll have auto-fallback to older model variant in place.

Emily: Smoke passed for US canary (first 15m), no errors. Will post full report in #incidents if anything pops.

Ben: Thanks all — locking branch at freeze.

Alice: Closing thread; will reopen if last-minute changes. :wave:
